name: Theldurin the Lost
summary: Theldurin the Lost wanders the Badlands alone, wary and half-mad. He fled the Twilight's Hammer with sacred relics after learning what the cult intended.

sections.title: A Mind Fractured by Darkness
sections.body:
Theldurin wanders the barren hills of the Badlands with bags of explosives, gripped by wild paranoia. He once belonged to the Twilight's Hammer. When the cult sought to awaken a primordial elemental power trapped beneath the earth, he recoiled in terror.

He rejected its teachings and fled into the desert. He carried the Scroll of Myzrael, hoping to keep his former masters from unleashing an ancient horror upon the world. His escape cost him his sanity, but his defiance dealt a serious blow to the cult's plans.

sections.title: A Desperate Countermeasure
sections.body: Enraged earth elementals ambushed Theldurin in the wastes and tore apart his stolen scroll, scattering the fragments across the dust. Paranoia besieges him, and visions haunt him of doom sleeping beneath the surface. The crazed dwarf seeks ancient texts, the Tablet of Ryun'eh and Yagyin's Digest, to uncover long-buried lore. He plans to force Myzrael's premature summoning so she can be defeated and bound again.

faq.answer: Theldurin is a half-mad dwarven hermit wandering the Badlands. Once a member of the Twilight's Hammer, he stole the Scroll of Myzrael and fled into the wilderness to stop the cult from unleashing a dangerous power.

faq.q: Why is Theldurin hiding in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Theldurin fled to the Badlands after stealing the Scroll of Myzrael from the Twilight's Hammer. He hides in its remote, sun-baked canyons, away from the cultists hunting him.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Myzrael?
faq.answer: The Scroll of Myzrael is an arcane parchment holding the ritual knowledge needed to release Myzrael, an ancient, corrupted elemental entity trapped deep beneath Arathi. Theldurin stole it to keep the Twilight's Hammer from completing the summoning, but local elementals later shredded it into pieces.

faq.q: What does Theldurin want to do with Myzrael?
faq.answer: The bindings on Myzrael are weakening, and Theldurin wants to summon her before she gathers her full strength. He hopes she can then be banished and sealed beneath the crust again before the Twilight's Hammer can master her power.

angles.text: Seeing a fellow son of Ironforge reduced to raving paranoia in a wasteland is tragic. Yet Theldurin's refusal to bow to dark cults shows the stubbornness dwarves are known for.
Theldurin threatens approaching strangers with a pack brimming with blastpowder, relying on volatile explosives in an unpredictable way.
